title: Encoding a fan-in-two circuit as 3-SAT
statement: Let $C$ be a well-formed acyclic Boolean circuit in which each gate has at most two inputs. Applying the circuit-to-3-SAT transformation to the encoding of $C$ yields exactly the binary serialization of the CNF formula formed from the circuit's Tseitin clauses together with the clause asserting that its output is true.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ is well formed: each gate has distinct input vertices and every NOT gate has exactly one input
Every gate of $C$ has at most two inputs
